content.text:
Parts (add_part name; get_part name for its parameters and a preview):
- alert_pop: A red ! pops up above a character's head with a bounce and burst lines, holds, then vanishes: spotted, surprised, warning. (one-shot; on the sprite centre; alert, exclamation, ui, surprise, warning, icon)
- aura_flames: Flickering tongues of power rising behind a standing character, a ring at the feet, sparks in front. (loop; on the ground at the feet; aura, power, buff, flames, charge, rage)
- blaster_bolt: A hot capsule of energy with a white core and speed lines behind, flying right (+x): laser, plasma or blaster shots. (loop; on the sprite centre; projectile, laser, blaster, energy, shot, bolt)
- blood_splat: A red splat on the hit point with droplets spraying out and falling. Stylised gore; recolour for green ichor or slime. (one-shot; on the sprite centre; blood, hit, gore, splatter, impact, droplets)
- bolt_strike: A bolt strikes down from above onto the anchor, flashes, a shockwave and sparks where it hits. (one-shot; on the ground at the feet; lightning, electric, bolt, storm, strike, thunder)
- breath_cone: A billowing cone of flame and sparks pouring right (+x) from the anchor: fire breath, flamethrower; frost or poison gas in other colours. (loop; on the sprite centre; breath, cone, flamethrower, spray, fire, gas)
- bubble_shield: A see-through dithered bubble around a character: bright rim, a shine highlight, glints running round: shield, barrier, protect. (loop; on the sprite centre; shield, bubble, barrier, protect, buff)
- bubbles_rise: Round bubbles of a few sizes rising and wobbling up from the ground: underwater, a bubbling pool, potions, drowning. (loop; on the ground at the feet; bubbles, water, underwater, rising, ambient, potion)
- buff_arrows: Up-arrows rising from the feet behind a character and fading out: a stat buff, power-up, attack or speed boost. (loop; on the ground at the feet; buff, arrows, status, powerup, rising)
- burn_status: Small flames licking up around and over a character, embers and a hot rim on the sprite: on fire, burn damage over time. (loop; on the ground at the feet; burn, fire, status, flames, dot)
- burning_edge: Sparks flickering up off the sprite's whole outline in a loop: on fire, powered up, cursed, overheating. (loop; on the sprite centre; outline, burn, aura, sparks, loop)
- campfire: A drawn campfire: five tongues from one hot bed, fanning out and flickering, a few sparks, lighting the scene. (loop; on the ground at the feet; fire, campfire, bonfire, camp, loop)
- candle_flame: A small calm drawn teardrop flame that sways a little, lighting the sprite: candles, lanterns, wicks, a match. (loop; on top of the head; fire, candle, flame, light, loop)
- cartoon_boom: A drawn cartoon explosion: a hot flash, lobed fire clouds thrown out and cooling, then smoke. Bombs, barrels, crits. (one-shot; on the sprite centre; explosion, fire, cartoon, boom, impact)
- charge_up: Motes of energy swirling in from all round and gathering at one point, a glow swelling there. Charging a spell. (one-shot; on the sprite centre; charge, gather, energy, magic, converge)
- charm_hearts: Three small pink hearts circling the head evenly, passing in front and behind, with twinkles: charmed, infatuated, love status. (loop; on top of the head; charm, hearts, love, status, orbit)
- claw_marks: Three parallel claw scratches ripping diagonally across the target, then crumbling away. Beast attacks, rakes, scratches. (one-shot; on the sprite centre; claw, scratch, slash, beast, hit, melee)
- claw_swipe: Three drawn claw marks raked across in a quick swipe, one a beat after the other, crumbling away. Beasts, monsters. (one-shot; on the sprite centre; claw, swipe, beast, scratch, hit)
- cloud_puff: A looping drawn cloud clump wobbling in place, lit from above. Rain or storm clouds over a head, sky decor, dreams. (loop; on top of the head; cloud, sky, weather, loop, cartoon)
- coin_burst: Gold coins pop out of the anchor with a flash ring and glints, arc up and fall away: loot drops, pickups, rewards. (one-shot; on the sprite centre; coins, loot, pickup, gold, reward, burst)
- collect_pop: A quick gold glint and ring popping on the anchor, sparkles drifting up and out: an item, coin or power-up being picked up. (one-shot; on the sprite centre; pickup, collect, sparkle, glint, item, reward)
- comet_trail: A bright head streaking across with a long tapered ribbon tail: comets, magic missiles, wisps; a throw's trail. (one-shot; on the sprite centre; comet, ribbon, trail, missile, projectile)
- confetti_pop: A pop of multicoloured paper confetti thrown up from the anchor, flipping as it falls: wins, celebrations, achievements. (one-shot; on the sprite centre; confetti, celebration, win, party, reward, burst)
- crater_dust: A ring of dust clouds billowing out and up from a ground impact, then breaking apart. Heavy landings, slams, boulders. (one-shot; on the ground at the feet; dust, impact, ground, slam, landing, cloud)
- curse_skulls: Little pale skulls drifting up around a character's head and fading, with dark motes: cursed, doomed, death mark, hex. (loop; on the sprite centre; curse, skulls, status, death, hex, debuff)
- debris_burst: Chunks of rock or wood thrown out of a hit, arcing down under gravity. (one-shot; on the sprite centre; debris, rocks, chunks, impact, break, rubble)
- debuff_arrows: Down-arrows sinking from above the head behind a character and fading: a stat debuff, weaken, slow or armour break. (loop; on the ground at the feet; debuff, arrows, status, weaken, curse)
- dust_kick: Two small dust puffs pushing out sideways along the ground and breaking up: footsteps, landings, skids, dashes. (one-shot; on the ground at the feet; dust, landing, footstep, ground, puff, jump)
- dust_puff: A small drawn dust puff kicked up from the ground: footsteps, jumps, an item dropping, a skid start. (one-shot; on the ground at the feet; dust, puff, ground, footstep, cartoon)
- dust_trail: Dust puffs rolling off the feet and trailing behind (to the left) as they break up. Loop for running, dashing, skidding. (loop; on the ground at the feet; dust, trail, run, dash, ground, loop)
- ember_rise: Glowing embers drifting up from the ground and winking out: fire, heat, burning. (loop; on the ground at the feet; embers, fire, sparks, rising, heat, ambient)
- fire_blast: A drawn explosion: a flash, round fire billows burning out into smoke puffs, a pressure ring. Noise version: fireball. (one-shot; on the sprite centre; explosion, fire, blast, boom, smoke)
- fire_ring: A ring of flickering flames standing on the ground around the anchor, embers rising: trapped in fire, burning ground, fire wall. (loop; on the ground at the feet; fire, ring, ground, flames, trap, area)
- fire_wall: A wide wall of drawn flame: seven tongues rising and flickering from one burning line. Fire walls, burning ground. (loop; on the ground at the feet; fire, wall, barrier, burning, loop)
- fireball: An explosion's fire mass: a flash, billowing fire that burns out into smoke, a pressure ring. (one-shot; on the sprite centre; explosion, fire, blast, boom, smoke)
- fireflies: Glowing fireflies drifting slowly and blinking on and off around the anchor: night, forests, swamps, calm magic. (loop; on the sprite centre; fireflies, night, nature, ambient, glow, forest)
- fireworks: A rocket streaking up and bursting into a falling shower of sparkles. Celebrations, victories, level-ups. (one-shot; on the sprite centre; fireworks, celebrate, victory, sparkle, burst)
- flame_aura: Drawn tongues of power rising behind a standing character, a ring at the feet, sparks. Noise version: aura_flames. (loop; on the ground at the feet; aura, power, buff, flames, charge, rage)
- flame_jet: A roaring jet of fire blasting sideways (to the right) from the anchor, widening into billows, sparks flying: flamethrower, fire breath. (loop; on the sprite centre; fire, jet, breath, flamethrower, stream, attack)
- flame_ring: A ring of drawn flame tongues on the ground around the anchor, embers rising: trapped in fire. Noise version: fire_ring. (loop; on the ground at the feet; fire, ring, ground, flames, trap, area)
- flame_tongue: One big drawn cartoon flame, wide at the root, its tip whipping and curling: fire elementals, a burning spot, a cartoon blaze. (loop; on the ground at the feet; fire, cartoon, flame, elemental, loop)
- flamethrower: A drawn jet of fire blasting right from the anchor, sparks flying: flamethrower, fire breath. Noise version: flame_jet. (loop; on the sprite centre; fire, jet, breath, flamethrower, stream, attack)
- flash_burst: A hit flash: a white-hot core, rays and a ring punching outward. The heart of a hit spark. (one-shot; on the sprite centre; hit, impact, flash, spark, punch, rays)
- freeze_status: Icy crust and cold tint on the sprite, ice crystals around the feet and glinting frost specks: frozen, chilled, slowed. (loop; on the ground at the feet; freeze, ice, status, frost, cold)
- frost_mist: Low cold mist drifting sideways in dithered bands around the feet, a few frost glints: winter, swamps, graveyards, spooky. (loop; on the ground at the feet; mist, fog, frost, cold, ground, ambient)
- grass_cut: Grass clippings bursting up from a cut tuft and falling back around it. Cutting bushes and grass, trampling, foliage hits. (one-shot; on the ground at the feet; grass, leaves, cut, bush, environment, nature)
- ground_cracks: Glowing cracks race out along the ground from the impact point, cool down and fade. Ground slams, earth magic, lava. (one-shot; on the ground at the feet; cracks, ground, slam, impact, earth, lava)
- heal_column: A soft column of light standing on the ground, a ring at its base and sparkles rising. (loop; on the ground at the feet; heal, holy, buff, light, pillar, column, restore)
- heal_plus: Green plus signs and motes float up off a body that flashes a glowing outline: healing received, regen ticks, potions. (one-shot; on the sprite centre; heal, plus, regen, potion, restore, ui)
- hit_star: A sharp star flashing on the hit point with specks flying off. The classic hit spark for punches and blows. (one-shot; on the sprite centre; hit, impact, spark, star, punch, flash)
- holy_aura: A golden radiance with light spikes behind a character, a glowing rim and streaks of light rising: blessed, divine, holy buff. (loop; on the sprite centre; holy, aura, light, buff, divine, blessing)
- hurt_flash: The sprite blinks white twice, its outline lit hot: the classic took-damage flash. Recolour red for damage, gold for buffs. (one-shot; on the sprite centre; hit, hurt, damage, flash, blink, sprite)
- ice_shatter: A flash and a ring of cold, then ice shards bursting out and tumbling down. Breaking a freeze, an ice spell's hit. (one-shot; on the sprite centre; ice, shatter, frost, break, hit)
- ice_spikes: A cluster of faceted ice spikes erupting from the ground under the anchor, holding, then sinking back: frost attacks, traps. (one-shot; on the ground at the feet; ice, frost, spikes, ground, attack, freeze)
- item_glint: A sharp four-point glint flashes now and then on an item's upper right, a smaller one lower left: shiny pickups, gems, loot. (loop; on the sprite centre; glint, shine, pickup, gem, loot, sparkle)
- landing_dust: Drawn dust clouds rolling out flat to both sides of a landing and thinning away. Heavy landings, stomps, slides. (one-shot; on the ground at the feet; dust, landing, ground, stomp, cartoon)
- lava_pool: A slowly churning pool of glowing lava on the ground with bubbles popping and embers: lava, molten ground, fire traps, hell. (loop; on the ground at the feet; lava, fire, pool, ground, molten, hazard)
- leaf_fall: Autumn leaves drifting down and swaying around the anchor: forests, autumn, wind, nature magic, a shaken tree. (loop; on the sprite centre; leaves, nature, autumn, weather, ambient, falling)
- level_up: A pillar of light bursts up from the feet, halos rise up the body, up-arrows and sparkles float away: level up, rank up, power gain. (one-shot; on the ground at the feet; levelup, pillar, buff, reward, holy, arrows)
- lightning_arcs: Small jagged arcs of electricity crackling on and off around a body, with spark glints: shocked, charged, electrified. (loop; on the sprite centre; lightning, electric, shock, status, crackle, charge)
- magic_orb: A glowing orb on the anchor with a tapered tail and motes streaming left: a magic missile flying right (+x). (loop; on the sprite centre; projectile, orb, magic, missile, spell, trail)
- muzzle_flash: A bright three-pronged flash bursting right (+x) from the anchor, then sparks and a smoke wisp: gunshots, cannons, wands. (one-shot; on the sprite centre; muzzle, flash, gun, shot, fire, projectile)
- on_fire: Small drawn flames licking up around a character, embers, a hot rim: on fire, burn damage. Noise version: burn_status. (loop; on the ground at the feet; burn, fire, status, flames, dot)
- orbit_motes: Glowing motes and glints circling a character, passing in front and behind: magic charge, enchantment, wisps, a buff. (loop; on the sprite centre; orbit, motes, magic, buff, arcane, aura)
- poison_bubbles: Green bubbles and specks rising off the body and popping, with a sickly pulsing rim on the sprite: poisoned, toxic, sick. (loop; on the sprite centre; poison, status, bubbles, toxic, debuff)
- portal_swirl: An upright swirling portal: churning core, glowing rim, orbiting motes. (loop; on the sprite centre; portal, void, gate, teleport, magic, arcane)
- rain_streaks: Rain falling straight down as thin streaks, near and far, with little splashes on the ground: wet weather, storms, gloom. (loop; on the ground at the feet; rain, weather, water, storm, ambient)
- rocket_exhaust: Round smoke puffs streaming left from an exhaust flame, flying right (+x): rockets, fire trails. Noise version: smoke_trail. (loop; on the sprite centre; trail, smoke, rocket, exhaust, projectile, missile)
- rune_circle: A magic circle on the ground: rings, a hexagram and a rune band turning slowly, twinkling motes. (loop; on the ground at the feet; magic, circle, sigil, summon, ground, arcane)
- rune_orbit: Four glowing rune glyphs evenly circling a character's waist on a faint ring, in front and behind: spellcasting, enchant, arcane buff. (loop; on the sprite centre; runes, orbit, arcane, magic, buff, enchant)
- scorch_mark: A charred patch on the ground with embers smouldering and flickering in it. Loop: after explosions, fire spells, burning. (loop; on the ground at the feet; scorch, burn, ground, fire, embers, aftermath)
- shadow_aura: Dark smoke wisps billowing up behind a character from a shadow pool, pale motes rising: dark power, curse, corruption. (loop; on the ground at the feet; shadow, aura, dark, curse, smoke, debuff)
- shield_break: A bubble shield flickering, then bursting in a flash into shards that fly out and fall. A broken guard or barrier. (one-shot; on the sprite centre; shield, break, barrier, bubble, shatter)
- shockwave_ring: A ring of force racing out along the ground with dust kicked up. A stomp, a landing, an impact. (one-shot; on the ground at the feet; impact, stomp, landing, ground, ring, dust)
- sky_beam: A pillar of light slams down onto the anchor, flares wide, rings out on the ground and thins away: smite, blessing, summon, revive. (one-shot; on the ground at the feet; beam, holy, light, smite, summon, revive)
- slam_dust: Round dust clouds billowing out and up from a ground impact: landings, slams, boulders. Noise version: crater_dust. (one-shot; on the ground at the feet; dust, impact, ground, slam, landing, cloud)
- slash_trail: A weapon swing: a bright crescent sweeping past the sprite, then dithering away. Sword, axe and claw swings. (one-shot; on the sprite centre; slash, swing, sword, melee, hit, arc)
- sleep_zzz: Z letters drifting up and to the right off the head, growing as they rise and fading: asleep, resting, sleep status. (loop; on the sprite centre; sleep, zzz, status, rest, idle)
- smoke_column: A looping column of drawn smoke puffs rising, swaying, growing and fading. Chimneys, campfires, burning wrecks. (loop; on the ground at the feet; smoke, column, chimney, fire, loop)
- smoke_poof: A drawn cartoon poof: round smoke puffs bursting out all round, rising and burning away. Vanish, teleport (z front hides the sprite). (one-shot; on the sprite centre; smoke, poof, cartoon, vanish, teleport)
- smoke_puff: A puff of smoke that billows up and thins away: dust clouds, poofs, after an explosion. (one-shot; on the sprite centre; smoke, puff, poof, dust, cloud)
- smoke_trail: A churning smoke plume streaming left from an exhaust flame on the anchor, flying right (+x): rockets; a fire trail in fire colour. (loop; on the sprite centre; trail, smoke, rocket, exhaust, projectile, missile)
- snowfall: Snowflakes drifting down around the anchor, near ones as little crystals, far ones as dots. (loop; on the sprite centre; snow, weather, winter, cold, ambient, ice)
- soft_glow: A soft pool of light on the ground, gently breathing: under a character, a pickup, a lamp. (loop; on the ground at the feet; glow, light, ground, pool, ambient, aura)
- spark_burst: Sparks flying out of a point and fading: hits, clashes, sword strikes, electricity. (one-shot; on the sprite centre; sparks, hit, clash, impact, electric)
- sparks_shower: Hot sparks spraying out of a point in a cone and arcing down: metal on metal, sword clashes, grinding, welding. (one-shot; on the sprite centre; sparks, metal, clash, hit, shower, impact)
- speed_lines: Pale wind streaks rushing left past the anchor, behind and over a sprite moving right (+x): dashes, sprints, charges. (loop; on the sprite centre; speed, dash, motion, wind, lines, movement)
- sprite_dust: The sprite's own pixels lifting off as dust and drifting away: disintegrate, fade out, teleport out (pair with the sprite's dissolve). (one-shot; on the sprite centre; disintegrate, dust, teleport, vanish, sprite)
- square_sigil: A ground seal of two counter-turning squares inside two rings, a glowing heart and motes rising: casting, warding, a trap glyph. (loop; on the ground at the feet; sigil, magic, circle, ground, ward, arcane)
- star_burst: Chunky cartoon stars pop out of the anchor in a ring and hang before blinking away: bonks, KOs, rewards, pickups. (one-shot; on the sprite centre; stars, cartoon, burst, hit, reward, pickup)
- steam_puffs: A steam jet from the ground, round puffs that billow up and dissolve: vents, geysers, kettles. Noise version: steam_vent. (loop; on the ground at the feet; steam, smoke, vent, geyser, rising, ambient)
- steam_vent: A hissing jet of steam from a point on the ground, puffs that billow up, widen and dissolve: vents, geysers, kettles, hot springs. (loop; on the ground at the feet; steam, smoke, vent, geyser, rising, ambient)
- stun_stars: Three little stars circling evenly just above the head on a faint ring, passing in front and behind: stunned, dazed, dizzy. (loop; on top of the head; stun, dizzy, stars, status, daze)
- swing_slash: A drawn weapon swing that whips: the edge races round, then is reeled in from behind and crumbles. Swords, axes. (one-shot; on the sprite centre; slash, sword, swing, melee, hit)
- teleport_in: Motes swirling in and a column of light narrowing to a flash where the sprite appears. Arrivals, summons, respawns. (one-shot; on the ground at the feet; teleport, arrive, summon, beam, magic)
- thrust_streak: A straight lance of light stabbing out from the sprite and fading forward, with speed lines. Spear, rapier, dash attacks. (one-shot; on the sprite centre; thrust, stab, spear, melee, dash, hit)
- torch_fire: A drawn torch flame: three teardrop tongues whipping at the tips, a spark or two, lighting the sprite. Torches, braziers. (loop; on top of the head; fire, torch, flame, brazier, loop)
- torch_flame: A small flickering teardrop flame with a licking tongue and a spark or two: torches, candles, braziers, a burning spot. (loop; on the ground at the feet; fire, flame, torch, light, ambient)
- twinkles: Little stars twinkling in and out around the anchor: magic, shine, enchantment, treasure. (loop; on the sprite centre; sparkles, twinkle, magic, shine, stars, ambient)
- vine_growth: Twisting green vines sprouting from the ground and curling up around the anchor, leaves popping, then withering: entangle, roots, nature. (one-shot; on the ground at the feet; nature, vines, roots, entangle, growth, ground)
- water_drips: Water drops forming on a body and dripping off its lower half, wet glints: soaked, wet status, just out of water, melting. (loop; on the sprite centre; water, drips, wet, status, soaked)
- water_ripple: Thin rings rippling out on a water surface around the feet, with glints. Loop for wading, standing in water, puddles. (loop; on the ground at the feet; water, ripple, wading, environment, ambient, puddle)
- water_splash: A crown of droplets thrown up out of water and falling back, with ripples spreading on the surface. Landings, dives, stones. (one-shot; on the ground at the feet; water, splash, droplets, ripple, landing, environment)
- wind_gusts: Light streaks of wind sweeping left to right across the anchor with flecks of debris: wind, gales, speed, haste. (loop; on the sprite centre; wind, air, gust, weather, speed, ambient)
- zigzag_slash: A slash along a path, not a circle: a zigzag (sharp corners, frantic cuts) or an S (smooth). Reshape it by patching its points. (one-shot; on the sprite centre; slash, zigzag, sword, axe, melee, hit, combo, path)

---
Other topics: start, recipe, craft, cookbook, edits, presets, tools, tool <name>

review before your next call: say what you see in the frames — does it read at 1x, start -> peak -> end (or a loop with no jump), anything cut off at the edges, muddy colours, is the sprite still readable — then choose: set_part or render with a patch (a defect you saw), get_part (unsure what a part can do), or export. Put that reasoning in `notes`.
